SITE_SRVC.USE_YN , SITE_SRVC.SITE_SRVC_NM , SITE_SRVC.SITE_SRVC_DESC , TO_CHAR(SITE_SRVC.RGST_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS RGST_DT , SITE_SRVC.RGST_SEQ , ( SELECT ADM_NM FROM SYS_ADM_INFO_TBL WHERE 1 = 1 AND ADM_SEQ = SITE_SRVC.RGST_SEQ ) AS RGST_NM , TO_CHAR(SITE_SRVC.UPDT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS UPDT_DT , SITE_SRVC.UPDT_SEQ , ( SELECT ADM_NM FROM SYS_ADM_INFO_TBL WHERE 1 = 1 AND ADM_SEQ = SITE_SRVC.UPDT_SEQ ) AS UPDT_NM FROM SVC_SITE_SRVC_MAP SITE_SRVC LEFT JOIN CMN_CHNL_SITE_MAP CHNL_SITE ON SITE_SRVC.CHNL_SITE_SEQ = CHNL_SITE.CHNL_SITE_SEQ WHERE 1 = 1 AND (((#{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (SITE_SRVC.USE_YN = #{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) AND (((#{chnlCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{chnlCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (SITE_SRVC.CHNL_CD = #{chnlCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) AND (((#{siteCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{siteCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (SITE_SRVC.SITE_CD = #{siteCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) AND (((#{srvcCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{srvcCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (SITE_SRVC.SRVC_CD = #{srvcCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) AND (((#{siteSrvcNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{siteSrvcNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (SITE_SRVC.SITE_SRVC_NM LIKE '%' || #{siteSrvcNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%')) ) SELECT TMP_SITE_SRVC.CHNL_SITE_SEQ , TMP_SITE_SRVC.CHNL_SEQ , TMP_SITE_SRVC.SITE_SEQ , TMP_SITE_SRVC.SRVC_SEQ , TMP_SITE_SRVC.CHNL_CD , TMP_SITE_SRVC.SITE_CD , TMP_SITE_SRVC.SRVC_CD , TMP_SITE_SRVC.USE_YN , TMP_SITE_SRVC.SITE_SRVC_NM , TMP_SITE_SRVC.SITE_SRVC_DESC , CHNL.CHNL_NM , CHNL.CHNL_IP , CHNL.CHNL_PORT , CHNL.CHNL_DMN , CHNL.CHNL_BSC_URI , CHNL.CHNL_DESC , SITE.SITE_TP , ( SELECT CD_NM FROM CMN_CD_INFO_TBL WHERE 1 = 1 AND GRP_CD = 'CMN_SITE_INFO_001' AND CD = SITE.SITE_TP ) AS SITE_TP_NM , SITE.SITE_NM , SITE.SITE_BSC_URI , SITE.SITE_DESC , SRVC.SRVC_CTGRY_CD , SRVC.SRVC_TP , ( SELECT CD_NM FROM CMN_CD_INFO_TBL WHERE 1 = 1 AND GRP_CD = 'SVC_SRVC_INFO_001' AND CD = SRVC.SRVC_TP ) AS SRVC_TP_NM , SRVC.SRVC_NM , SRVC.SRVC_BSC_URI , SRVC.SRVC_DESC , TMP_SITE_SRVC.RGST_DT , TMP_SITE_SRVC.RGST_SEQ , TMP_SITE_SRVC.RGST_NM , TMP_SITE_SRVC.UPDT_DT , TMP_SITE_SRVC.UPDT_SEQ , TMP_SITE_SRVC.UPDT_NM FROM TMP_SITE_SRVC_TBL TMP_SITE_SRVC LEFT OUTER JOIN CMN_CHNL_INFO_TBL CHNL ON TMP_SITE_SRVC.CHNL_SEQ = CHNL.CHNL_SEQ AND CHNL.USE_YN = 'Y' LEFT OUTER JOIN CMN_SITE_INFO_TBL SITE ON TMP_SITE_SRVC.SITE_SEQ = SITE.SITE_SEQ AND SITE.USE_YN = 'Y' LEFT OUTER JOIN SVC_SRVC_INFO_TBL SRVC ON TMP_SITE_SRVC.SRVC_SEQ = SRVC.SRVC_SEQ AND SRVC.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE 1 = 1
